en.g: Use was and were to talk about the past of to be.
p: I, he, she and it take was: I was at home, she was tired.
You, we and they take were: we were happy, they were late.
Questions flip the order: Were you at work? Was it good?
en.q: Where were you yesterday at eight in the evening?

de.g: Du lernst was und were, die Vergangenheit von to be.

es.q: ¿Dónde estabas ayer a las ocho de la tarde?
es.c: Escribe cuatro frases sobre el domingo pasado con was y were.

Pour une question, on inverse : Were you at work? Was it good?
fr.q: Où étais-tu hier à huit heures du soir ?

en.g: Talk about finished actions with regular verbs ending in -ed.
p: Most verbs just add -ed: work becomes worked, visit becomes visited.
Verbs ending in -e add -d: live becomes lived. Consonant plus -y: study becomes studied.
The form is the same for every person: I played, she played, they played.
en.q: What did you do last weekend? Use two regular verbs in your answer.
en.c: Write five things you did yesterday with regular -ed verbs.

de.g: Du erzählst abgeschlossene Handlungen mit regelmäßigen Verben auf -ed.
p: Meist hängst du einfach -ed an: work wird worked, visit wird visited.
Endet das Verb auf -e, nur -d: live wird lived. Konsonant plus -y: study wird studied.
Die Form ist für alle Personen gleich: I played, she played, they played.
de.q: Was hast du letztes Wochenende gemacht? Nutze zwei regelmäßige Verben.
de.c: Schreib fünf Dinge, die du gestern gemacht hast, mit regelmäßigen -ed-Verben.

es.g: Habla de acciones terminadas con verbos regulares en -ed.
p: Casi todos solo añaden -ed: work pasa a worked, visit pasa a visited.
Si acaban en -e, solo -d: live pasa a lived. Consonante más -y: study pasa a studied.
La forma es igual para todas las personas: I played, she played, they played.

fr.g: Parler d'actions terminées avec les verbes réguliers en -ed.
p: La plupart ajoutent juste -ed : work devient worked, visit devient visited.
Finale en -e : juste -d, live devient lived. Consonne plus -y : study devient studied.
La forme est la même pour tous : I played, she played, they played.
fr.q: Qu'as-tu fait le week-end dernier ? Utilise deux verbes réguliers.
fr.c: Écris cinq choses que tu as faites hier avec des verbes réguliers en -ed.

it.g: Parli di azioni concluse con i verbi regolari in -ed.
p: Quasi tutti aggiungono solo -ed: work diventa worked, visit diventa visited.
Se finiscono in -e, solo -d: live diventa lived. Consonante più -y: study diventa studied.
La forma è uguale per tutte le persone: I played, she played, they played.
it.q: Cosa hai fatto lo scorso weekend? Usa due verbi regolari.
it.c: Scrivi cinque cose che hai fatto ieri con verbi regolari in -ed.

A forma é igual para todas as pessoas: I played, she played, they played.
pt.q: O que fizeste no fim de semana passado? Usa dois verbos regulares.
pt.c: Escreve cinco coisas que fizeste ontem com verbos regulares em -ed.

vocab.ex: I worked from home on Monday.
She played tennis with her brother.

target.gram: Past simple regular verbs: base + -ed (worked), -e + -d (lived), consonant + y becomes -ied (studied). Same form for all persons.

en.g: Say the -ed ending of regular verbs with the right sound.
p: After sounds like p, k, s, sh, ch, -ed sounds like /t/: walked, stopped, watched.
After voiced sounds like n, l, v or a vowel, it sounds like /d/: played, lived, cleaned.
After t or d, add a syllable /id/: wanted, needed, visited.
en.q: Can you say walked, played and wanted aloud? Which one has an extra syllable?
en.c: Sort ten -ed verbs into three groups: /t/, /d/ and /id/, then say them aloud.

de.g: Du sprichst die Endung -ed regelmäßiger Verben richtig aus.
p: Nach Lauten wie p, k, s, sh, ch klingt -ed wie /t/: walked, stopped, watched.
Nach stimmhaften Lauten wie n, l, v oder Vokalen klingt es wie /d/: played, lived, cleaned.
Nach t oder d kommt eine Silbe /id/ dazu: wanted, needed, visited.
de.q: Kannst du walked, played und wanted laut sagen? Welches hat eine Silbe mehr?
de.c: Sortiere zehn -ed-Verben in drei Gruppen: /t/, /d/ und /id/, und sprich sie laut.

es.g: Pronuncia bien la terminación -ed de los verbos regulares.
p: Tras sonidos como p, k, s, sh, ch, -ed suena /t/: walked, stopped, watched.
Tras sonidos sonoros como n, l, v o vocal, suena /d/: played, lived, cleaned.
Tras t o d, se añade una sílaba /id/: wanted, needed, visited.
es.q: ¿Puedes decir walked, played y wanted en voz alta? ¿Cuál tiene una sílaba más?
es.c: Clasifica diez verbos en -ed en tres grupos: /t/, /d/ e /id/, y dilos en voz alta.

fr.g: Prononcer correctement la finale -ed des verbes réguliers.
p: Après des sons comme p, k, s, sh, ch, -ed se dit /t/ : walked, stopped, watched.
Après un son sonore comme n, l, v ou une voyelle, il se dit /d/ : played, lived, cleaned.
Après t ou d, on ajoute une syllabe /id/ : wanted, needed, visited.
fr.q: Peux-tu dire walked, played et wanted à voix haute ? Lequel a une syllabe de plus ?
fr.c: Classe dix verbes en -ed en trois groupes : /t/, /d/ et /id/, puis dis-les à voix haute.

it.g: Pronunci bene la desinenza -ed dei verbi regolari.
p: Dopo suoni come p, k, s, sh, ch, -ed si legge /t/: walked, stopped, watched.
Dopo suoni sonori come n, l, v o una vocale, si legge /d/: played, lived, cleaned.
Dopo t o d si aggiunge una sillaba /id/: wanted, needed, visited.
it.q: Sai dire ad alta voce walked, played e wanted? Quale ha una sillaba in più?
it.c: Dividi dieci verbi in -ed in tre gruppi: /t/, /d/ e /id/, poi dilli ad alta voce.

pt.g: Pronuncia bem a terminação -ed dos verbos regulares.
p: Depois de sons como p, k, s, sh, ch, -ed soa /t/: walked, stopped, watched.
Depois de sons vozeados como n, l, v ou vogal, soa /d/: played, lived, cleaned.
Depois de t ou d, junta-se uma sílaba /id/: wanted, needed, visited.
pt.q: Consegues dizer walked, played e wanted em voz alta? Qual tem uma sílaba a mais?
pt.c: Separa dez verbos em -ed em três grupos: /t/, /d/ e /id/, e di-los em voz alta.

pt_BR.g: Pronuncie direito a terminação -ed dos verbos regulares.
p: Depois de sons como p, k, s, sh, ch, o -ed soa /t/: walked, stopped, watched.
Depois de sons sonoros como n, l, v ou vogal, soa /d/: played, lived, cleaned.
Depois de t ou d, entra uma sílaba /id/: wanted, needed, visited.
pt_BR.q: Você consegue dizer walked, played e wanted em voz alta? Qual tem uma sílaba a mais?
pt_BR.c: Separe dez verbos em -ed em três grupos: /t/, /d/ e /id/, e fale todos em voz alta.

en.g: Learn the irregular past forms you use every day.
p: Some verbs change completely: go becomes went, see becomes saw, eat becomes ate.
Others change a little: have becomes had, make becomes made, get becomes got.
Learn them in small groups and use them in real sentences every day.
en.q: What did you eat yesterday, and where did you go after work or school?
en.c: Write a mini diary of yesterday using went, had, saw, ate, got and came.

en.g: Ask questions about the past with did and the base verb.

en.g: Say what did not happen with didn't and the base verb.

For was and were, just add not: I wasn't hungry, they weren't there.

vocab.ex: On Saturday morning I went to the market.
First, I had a big breakfast.
Then I met my friends in the park.
After that, we watched a film.
We played football. It was fun!
In the evening I stayed at home.

target.gram: Tell a story in order with the past simple and sequencers: first, then, after that, in the end.

en.t: Time words: yesterday, last week, ago
en.g: Place events in the past with time words like yesterday, last and ago.
p: Yesterday works alone: yesterday, yesterday morning, yesterday evening.
Last comes before the period: last night, last week, last year, without the.
Ago comes after the time: two days ago, ten minutes ago, a long time ago.
en.q: When did you last see a film at the cinema? Answer with ago.
en.c: Write five sentences about past events, each with a different time word.

de.g: Du ordnest Ereignisse mit yesterday, last und ago in die Vergangenheit ein.
p: Yesterday steht allein: yesterday, yesterday morning, yesterday evening.
Last steht vor dem Zeitraum: last night, last week, last year, ohne the.
Ago steht hinter der Zeit: two days ago, ten minutes ago, a long time ago.
de.q: Wann warst du zuletzt im Kino? Antworte mit ago.
de.c: Schreib fünf Sätze über Vergangenes, jeder mit einem anderen Zeitwort.

es.t: Palabras de tiempo: yesterday, last, ago
es.g: Sitúa hechos en el pasado con yesterday, last y ago.
p: Yesterday va solo: yesterday, yesterday morning, yesterday evening.
Last va antes del periodo: last night, last week, last year, sin the.
Ago va después del tiempo: two days ago, ten minutes ago, a long time ago.
es.q: ¿Cuándo fuiste al cine por última vez? Contesta con ago.
es.c: Escribe cinco frases sobre el pasado, cada una con una palabra de tiempo distinta.

fr.t: Mots de temps : yesterday, last, ago
fr.g: Situer des faits dans le passé avec yesterday, last et ago.
p: Yesterday s'emploie seul : yesterday, yesterday morning, yesterday evening.
Last se place avant la période : last night, last week, last year, sans the.
Ago se place après la durée : two days ago, ten minutes ago, a long time ago.
fr.q: Quand es-tu allé au cinéma pour la dernière fois ? Réponds avec ago.
fr.c: Écris cinq phrases sur le passé, chacune avec un mot de temps différent.

it.t: Parole di tempo: yesterday, last, ago
it.g: Collochi i fatti nel passato con yesterday, last e ago.
p: Yesterday sta da solo: yesterday, yesterday morning, yesterday evening.
Last va prima del periodo: last night, last week, last year, senza the.
Ago va dopo il tempo: two days ago, ten minutes ago, a long time ago.
it.q: Quando sei andato al cinema l'ultima volta? Rispondi con ago.
it.c: Scrivi cinque frasi sul passato, ognuna con una parola di tempo diversa.

pt.t: Palavras de tempo: yesterday, last, ago
pt.g: Situa acontecimentos no passado com yesterday, last e ago.
p: Yesterday usa-se sozinho: yesterday, yesterday morning, yesterday evening.
Last vem antes do período: last night, last week, last year, sem the.
Ago vem depois do tempo: two days ago, ten minutes ago, a long time ago.
pt.q: Quando foste ao cinema pela última vez? Responde com ago.
pt.c: Escreve cinco frases sobre o passado, cada uma com uma palavra de tempo diferente.

pt_BR.t: Palavras de tempo: yesterday, last, ago
pt_BR.g: Situe fatos no passado com yesterday, last e ago.
p: Yesterday aparece sozinho: yesterday, yesterday morning, yesterday evening.
Last vem antes do período: last night, last week, last year, sem the.
Ago vem depois do tempo: two days ago, ten minutes ago, a long time ago.
pt_BR.q: Quando você foi ao cinema pela última vez? Responda com ago.
pt_BR.c: Escreva cinco frases sobre o passado, cada uma com uma palavra de tempo diferente.

vocab.ex: I went running yesterday morning.
We had dinner with friends last night.
She started a new job last week.
They moved to a new city last year.
I bought these shoes two days ago.
I visited London a long time ago.

target.gram: Past time words: yesterday (+ morning), last + night/week/year (no the), time period + ago (two days ago).

en.g: Use ordinal numbers for dates, floors and rankings.
p: The special ones: first, second, third. Then add -th: fourth, fifth, tenth.
Big numbers use the last digit: twenty-first, thirty-second, forty-third.
Dates: the fifth of May or May fifth. Floors: I live on the third floor.
en.q: When is your birthday? Say the date with an ordinal number.
en.c: Write the dates of five important days in your year using ordinal numbers.

de.g: Du benutzt Ordnungszahlen für Daten, Stockwerke und Platzierungen.
p: Die besonderen: first, second, third. Danach -th: fourth, fifth, tenth.
Bei großen Zahlen zählt die letzte Ziffer: twenty-first, thirty-second, forty-third.
Daten: the fifth of May oder May fifth. Etage: I live on the third floor.
de.q: Wann hast du Geburtstag? Sag das Datum mit einer Ordnungszahl.
de.c: Schreib die Daten von fünf wichtigen Tagen deines Jahres mit Ordnungszahlen.

es.g: Usa los ordinales para fechas, pisos y clasificaciones.
p: Los especiales: first, second, third. Luego se añade -th: fourth, fifth, tenth.
En números grandes manda la última cifra: twenty-first, thirty-second, forty-third.
Fechas: the fifth of May o May fifth. Pisos: I live on the third floor.
es.q: ¿Cuándo es tu cumpleaños? Di la fecha con un ordinal.
es.c: Escribe las fechas de cinco días importantes de tu año con ordinales.

fr.g: Utiliser les ordinaux pour les dates, les étages et les classements.
p: Les spéciaux : first, second, third. Ensuite on ajoute -th : fourth, fifth, tenth.
Pour les grands nombres, c'est le dernier chiffre qui compte : twenty-first, thirty-second.
Dates : the fifth of May ou May fifth. Étage : I live on the third floor.
fr.q: Quand est ton anniversaire ? Dis la date avec un ordinal.
fr.c: Écris les dates de cinq jours importants de ton année avec des ordinaux.

it.g: Usi gli ordinali per date, piani e classifiche.
p: Quelli speciali: first, second, third. Poi si aggiunge -th: fourth, fifth, tenth.
Nei numeri grandi conta l'ultima cifra: twenty-first, thirty-second, forty-third.
Date: the fifth of May o May fifth. Piani: I live on the third floor.
it.q: Quando è il tuo compleanno? Di' la data con un ordinale.
it.c: Scrivi le date di cinque giorni importanti del tuo anno con gli ordinali.

pt.g: Usa os ordinais para datas, andares e classificações.
p: Os especiais: first, second, third. Depois junta-se -th: fourth, fifth, tenth.
Nos números grandes conta o último algarismo: twenty-first, thirty-second, forty-third.
Datas: the fifth of May ou May fifth. Andares: I live on the third floor.
pt.q: Quando é o teu aniversário? Diz a data com um ordinal.
pt.c: Escreve as datas de cinco dias importantes do teu ano com ordinais.

pt_BR.g: Use os ordinais para datas, andares e classificações.
p: Os especiais: first, second, third. Depois entra o -th: fourth, fifth, tenth.
Nos números grandes vale o último algarismo: twenty-first, thirty-second, forty-third.
Datas: the fifth of May ou May fifth. Andares: I live on the third floor.
pt_BR.q: Quando é o seu aniversário? Diga a data com um ordinal.
pt_BR.c: Escreva as datas de cinco dias importantes do seu ano com ordinais.

vocab.ex: January is the first month of the year.
She finished second in the race.
Our flat is on the third floor.
My birthday is on the fifth of June.
December is the twelfth month.
The party is on the twenty-first.

target.gram: Ordinals: first, second, third, then number + -th (fourth). Dates: the fifth of May / May fifth. Floors: on the third floor.

en.g: Learn the words and wishes for birthdays and special days.
p: Happy birthday! is the classic wish. Many happy returns! is extra friendly.
Congratulations! is for good news: a new job, a wedding, passing an exam.
Happy New Year! and Have a great holiday! work for seasonal celebrations.
en.q: How did you celebrate your last birthday? Use the past simple.
en.c: Write a short birthday message in English for a friend or family member.

de.g: Du lernst Wörter und Wünsche für Geburtstage und besondere Tage.
p: Happy birthday! ist der klassische Wunsch. Many happy returns! klingt besonders herzlich.
Congratulations! passt zu guten Nachrichten: neuer Job, Hochzeit, bestandene Prüfung.
Happy New Year! und Have a great holiday! passen zu Festen im Jahr.
de.q: Wie hast du deinen letzten Geburtstag gefeiert? Benutze das past simple.
de.c: Schreib eine kurze Geburtstagsnachricht auf Englisch an Freunde oder Familie.

es.g: Aprende palabras y felicitaciones para cumpleaños y días especiales.
p: Happy birthday! es la felicitación clásica. Many happy returns! suena muy cariñoso.
Congratulations! es para buenas noticias: un trabajo nuevo, una boda, aprobar un examen.
Happy New Year! y Have a great holiday! sirven para las fiestas del año.
es.q: ¿Cómo celebraste tu último cumpleaños? Usa el past simple.
es.c: Escribe un breve mensaje de cumpleaños en inglés para un amigo o familiar.

fr.g: Apprendre les mots et les vœux pour les anniversaires et jours spéciaux.
p: Happy birthday! est le vœu classique. Many happy returns! est très chaleureux.
Congratulations! sert pour les bonnes nouvelles : nouveau travail, mariage, examen réussi.
Happy New Year! et Have a great holiday! conviennent aux fêtes de l'année.
fr.q: Comment as-tu fêté ton dernier anniversaire ? Utilise le past simple.
fr.c: Écris un court message d'anniversaire en anglais pour un ami ou un proche.

it.g: Impari parole e auguri per compleanni e giorni speciali.
p: Happy birthday! è l'augurio classico. Many happy returns! è molto affettuoso.
Congratulations! è per le belle notizie: un nuovo lavoro, un matrimonio, un esame superato.
Happy New Year! e Have a great holiday! vanno bene per le feste dell'anno.
it.q: Come hai festeggiato il tuo ultimo compleanno? Usa il past simple.
it.c: Scrivi un breve messaggio di compleanno in inglese per un amico o un familiare.

pt.g: Aprende palavras e votos para aniversários e dias especiais.
p: Happy birthday! é o voto clássico. Many happy returns! é muito carinhoso.
Congratulations! é para boas notícias: um emprego novo, um casamento, passar num exame.
Happy New Year! e Have a great holiday! servem para as festas do ano.
pt.q: Como celebraste o teu último aniversário? Usa o past simple.
pt.c: Escreve uma mensagem curta de aniversário em inglês para um amigo ou familiar.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda palavras e votos para aniversários e dias especiais.
p: Happy birthday! é o parabéns clássico. Many happy returns! é bem carinhoso.
Congratulations! é para boas notícias: emprego novo, casamento, passar numa prova.
Happy New Year! e Have a great holiday! servem para as festas do ano.
pt_BR.q: Como você comemorou seu último aniversário? Use o past simple.
pt_BR.c: Escreva uma mensagem curta de aniversário em inglês para um amigo ou parente.

vocab.ex: Happy birthday, Maria! Have a great day!
You passed the exam? Congratulations!
Happy New Year to you and your family!
We made a chocolate birthday cake.
I bought her a present.
We celebrated with a picnic in the park.

target.gram: Wishes use Happy + occasion (Happy birthday!), Congratulations! for success, Have a great + noun! (Have a great day!).
